use.purpose: Config channel: 64-byte feature report 0 (GET answers through GET_FEATURE; SET has no reply)

linux.notes: Needs a udev rule for hidraw

limitations: Nothing here has been verified on hardware by UDB; OpenMouse tested the protocol on this model.
Live settings only: changes are lost when the mouse powers off, and iCUE overwrites them when it re-applies its profile.
Polling rate, the stage mask, onboard profiles, buttons and lighting are not implemented.
